entities.text: High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The petitioner apprehending his arrest in connection with the case registered under Sections 420/467/468/471 IPC has prayed for grant of anticipatory bail.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has been falsely implicated in this case and has not committed any offence as alleged in the compliant leading to lodging of the present F.I.R.
It is further submitted that the petitioner has been roped in the present case by the complainant/informant on the basis of false and fabricated documents with an intention to grab his land.
Earlier also a proceeding under Section 107 Cr.P.C
was initiated with respect to the land in question.
Moreover, Original (Title) Suit No. 26/2021 is also pending in the Court of the Civil Judge (Sr. Div.)-VI, Hazaribagh with respect to the said land.

entities.text: Court of the Civil Judge (Sr. Div.)-VI, Hazaribagh
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: False implication of the petitioner would also be evident from the fact that there is delay of about six years in lodging of the complaint.

Otherwise also, the petitioner being the vendor of the land in question had merely presented the sale deed for registration before the District Sub-Registrar, Hazaribagh, however, the same was refused.

Co-accused Govind Mahto and Dinesh Mehta, the proposed purchasers of the land in question, have already been granted anticipatory bail by a coordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 21.03.2024 passed in A.B.A. No. 10213/2023.
The petitioner has no criminal antecedent as has been stated in paragraph 17 of the present Hamid Mian vs The State Of Jharkhand .....
